description: This Java class `ReadOrigInd` is part of an MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) API implementation, representing a 'Read Original Indication' PDU (Protocol Data Unit). It provides methods to access and modify message headers such as date, sender, message ID, read status, and recipients.
